home.bossDropMechanic: When you kill this boss, bats are summoned; killing them can drop all the items below by the end of the fight.

detail.bossDropMechanicDetail: These bosses summon bats on death; this item can drop when you kill those bats.
detail.gameLevelDetail: This item can drop depending on the player's game level (and the monster's region/class). Possible ranges:
detail.eliteClassLegend: For elites (Superelite / Megaelite): CLASS = monster class level (0 to 21), Reg = region number (1 to 4). Higher CLASS means more varied drops.
detail.sourcesLegendRegular: entities/regular/regNlLtT — Regular monsters: regN = region (1-4), l = monster CLASS, t = game level bracket (t1 = 0-4, t7 = 30-34, t14 = 65+).
detail.sourcesLegendChest: chest/regN/cXtY — Chests: regN = region, c = phase/level (1-10), t = chest type. Suffixes (_littlekey, _bigkey, etc.) = chest variant.
detail.sourcesLegendBoss: entities/boss/… — Bosses and elites: dedicated rewards, coins (coins_rewards), runes (runes_*), etc.
